facts.fact: The IPDCP briefed ministry cabinet directors and secretaries-general on their obligations as data controllers under law no. 2019-014 of 29 October 2019, treating the law as applicable to public administrations.
facts.system: Loi n°2019-014 relative à la protection des données à caractère personnel

facts.fact: The IPDCP became operational in 2024 and, per its head Colonel Bédiani Belei, holds powers of control, injunction and sanction.

The IPDCP convened a compliance awareness meeting for public administrations in Lomé on 15 September 2026, covering prior formalities, declaration of existing processing and designation of correspondents; no sanction is reported.
facts.system: Loi n°2019-014 relative à la protection des données à caractère personnel

facts.fact: On 15 September 2026 the IPDCP pressed administrations to speed compliance and said a correspondent certification programme was envisaged.
